# Jaypal Sapara

Website: https://jaypalsapara.in

## Overview

Jaypal Sapara is a full stack web developer focused on building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications.

His primary expertise is Laravel backend development with React frontends. He develops complete SaaS platforms, business systems, REST APIs, payment integrations, authentication systems, and enterprise web applications.

He works with clients from idea validation through architecture, implementation, deployment, maintenance, and scaling.
